marketSnapshot.headline: Underwrite any rental in 60 seconds — without the spreadsheet.
marketSnapshot.body: TrueCap was built to replace the 30-minute spreadsheet underwrite with something that takes a minute. Paste an address, get real numbers: cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, 10-year projection, sensitivity grid, max allowable offer. Below are three deal examples that took 60 seconds each to analyze — then a quick walk-through of what you get if you try it.

dealSpotter.body: $420k duplex with both units rented at $1,950 each. TrueCap pulled the property tax bill from Philly's records, calculated cap rate, cash-on-cash, monthly net cash flow, DSCR, and flagged the 1925 build year as a year-1 capex risk. The full underwrite — including 10-year projection and sensitivity grid — took 47 seconds. This is the kind of deal where the verdict isn't 'buy or walk' but 'understand the trade-offs.'

dealSpotter.address: Indianapolis, IN — Mars Hill SFR example
dealSpotter.body: $185k 3/1.5 ranch at $1,475 rent. Working-class neighborhood, school rating C+. TrueCap auto-filled the rent estimate from HUD data, pulled local property taxes, and surfaced this as a yield play with limited appreciation tailwind. The kind of nuance that takes 20 minutes to develop manually in a spreadsheet — and that you can miss entirely if you're rushing.

$245k 3-unit listed at headline cap rate of 9.1%. TrueCap recalculates with realistic vacancy + capex reserves at investor-loan rates — DSCR drops to 1.04, which is below most lenders' funding threshold. This is the gap between listing-page math and real underwriting that costs investors money. The numbers TrueCap surfaces are the ones you'd compute yourself in a spreadsheet — just in 60 seconds instead of 30 minutes.

qa.question: Why should I use TrueCap instead of my spreadsheet (or BiggerPockets, or DealCheck, or Mashvisor)?
qa.answer: Three reasons. (1) Speed. Pasting an address auto-fills property taxes, rent estimates from HUD, year-built, building age, square footage. You start with 60-70% of the underwrite done before you type a single number. The competition makes you enter everything manually. (2) Honest math. TrueCap shows you cap rate, cash-on-cash, AND DSCR — not just one. It flags when the headline numbers diverge from the financed reality. Most calculators show you the answer you want; TrueCap shows you the answer that's true. (3) Pro tools (sensitivity grids, 10-year projections, MAO calculator, PDF reports, portfolio rollup) that actually help you DECIDE — not just calculate. You'll know whether to buy, walk, or negotiate within 60 seconds, every time. The free tier is enough to run unlimited basic analyses. Try it on a deal you're considering and see how it compares to what you'd do in Excel.
